subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by artifacts.download follow the existing operator.read artifact contract or require operator.admin?
rationale: Both scopes are technically implementable, but deciding which trusted operator role may receive locally stored generated-image bytes is a Gateway authorization-policy choice that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Keep operator.read
options.body: Allow read-scoped artifact downloads only after the session, stored record, managed URL, transcript reference, and coordinates all match.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Restrict managed-image bytes to administrators and update protocol wording, UI recovery, and tests together.

recommendation.title: Keep operator.read
recommendation.body: Allow read-scoped artifact downloads only after the session, stored record, managed URL, transcript reference, and coordinates all match.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion directly requests this Gateway authorization decision from them.
